'''Kalevala''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where it occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the cognominal [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]]. A neighbor of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]]' traditional [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], Kalevala's terrain primarily comprised a [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] [[Desert/Legends|desertscape]]. The planet was host to members of the pacifistic [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] political faction, and even spawned a noble lineage whence came the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]] just prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Senator/Legends|Represented]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] by Merrik in the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Clone Wars, and those leading up to the galaxy-spanning conflict, Kalevala was the site of a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Bombing on Kalevala/Legends|bombing]] by the violent [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] group that [[Death/Legends|claimed the life]] of the New Mandalorian [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]], [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec]].

==Description==
Kalevala occupied the fourth [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector's]] [[Mandalore system/Legends|Mandalore system]], making it a neighbor of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tracyn]] and the traditional [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. Circling the [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Star/Legends|sun]], also known as [[Mandalore (star)/Legends|Mandalore]], Kalevala was a world blanketed in [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]].<ref name="TEA" /> Following the rise of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorian]] faction circa [[738 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> Kalevala became home to a number of New Mandalorians, with recognized titles such as [[Duke/Legends|duchess]]<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> and [[Prince/Legends|prince]].<ref name="VoT">{{TCW|Voyage of Temptation}}</ref> On Kalevala, [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|expensive]] [[Wine/Legends|wine]]<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> and rich fabrics were produced.<ref name="TCWCE" /> [[Quench-gourd]]s grew on Kalevala,<ref name="TBHC" /> and at least one unique [[Hair/Legends|hairstyle]] evolved on the Outer Rim world.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Starship/Legends|shipwrights]] of [[Kalevala Spaceworks/Legends|Kalevala Spaceworks]]<ref name="TCWIV">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]''</ref> also made the planet their home.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" />

==History==
{{Quote|Sadly, Deputy Minister Jerec perished this morning, in a Death Watch bombing on Kalevala. Let us ensure that his death was not in vain.|[[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="DoM">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>}}
[[File:New_Mandalorians.png|thumb|left|250px|Kalevalan natives Duchess [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and Prince [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]]]]
After the [[Taung/Legends|Taung]] forces of [[Mandalore the First/Legends|Mandalore the First]] journeyed from [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] to conquer the planet that became Mandalore,<ref name="TEA" /> the newly renamed Mandalorians spread out to conquer the planets of the surrounding system,<ref name="HotM">{{InsiderCite|80|The History of the Mandalorians: Exploring the Evolution of a Mighty Race of Warriors}}</ref> including Kalevala.<ref name="TEA" />

In the years following the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan|defeat]] of the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] at [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], and the subsequent Republic [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|reformation]] that marked the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], the Mandalorians on Mandalore remade themselves into a more technologically adept and more rigid, militant society. The rise in Mandalore's militancy so soon after the devastating war with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] alarmed both the Republic and its [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] protectors.<ref name="TEA" /> Unwilling to suffer through a second Mandalorian War, the Jedi led a Republic strike force in a [[Mandalorian Excision|brief and targeted conflict]] with the Mandalorians in 738 BBY that brought devastation to the worlds of the Mandalore sector.<ref name="Warfare" /> Out of this disaster arose a pacifist sect calling themselves the New Mandalorians; the reformist [[Politics/Legends|political]] faction renounced violence and the [[Canons of Honor|warrior codes]] of the Mandalorians' past, instead preaching peace, neutrality, and tolerance. The New Mandalorians formed a new society separate from the Mandalorian warrior clans,<ref name="TEA" /> in the [[Color/Legends|white]]-sand deserts of Mandalore.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> At some point in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] history, the New Mandalorians also established a presence on the nearby world of Kalevala.<ref name="DoM" />

In the late [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the Galactic Republic,<ref name="VoT" /> Kalevala became the birthplace of [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] and [[Tal Merrik/Legends|Tal Merrik]].<ref name="TCWCE" /> Kryze later relocated to Mandalore, and though she had been born into the Mandalorian warrior clans,<ref name="TBHC" /> she dedicated herself to peace and eventually became a duchess and the [[Anti-Mandalore|leader]] of the New Mandalorian people.<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Merrik was a prince,<ref name="VoT" /> who came to represent Kalevala and the surrounding Mandalore system as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic senate]].<ref name="NewBattlefronts" /> Kalevala's premier starship manufacturer, Kalevala Spaceworks, constructed Kryze's personal [[Transport/Legends|transport]], the luxurious [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]].<ref name="TCWIV" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the first year of the galaxy-spanning [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the Separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Merrik was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when it was [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|revealed]] that he was in league with the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]],<ref name="VoT" /> a radically violent Mandalorian splinter faction returning to the galactic stage after years in hiding.<ref name="TBHC" /> Soon after, the Death Watch orchestrated a [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] [[Bombing on Kalevala/Legends|bombing on Kalevala]] that killed the New Mandalorians' [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]], [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec]].<ref name="DoM" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Obi-Wan Kenobi was reunited with an old friend: the Duchess Satine of Kalevala.|News reel narrator|<ref name="VoT" />}}
Kalevala was first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe via a mention in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="TCSWE" /> During the news reel opening of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|second season]] episode "[[Voyage of Temptation]]," Kalevala was mentioned as the homeworld of Duchess Satine Kryze,<ref name="VoT" /> and the planet was again mentioned by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine in the following episode, "[[Duchess of Mandalore]]."<ref name="DoM" /> In these two television appearances, the planet's name was pronounced in two distinctly different ways. In the news reel of the episode "Voyage of Temptation," the show's narrator pronounced the planet's name "Kale-vah-lah",<ref name="VoT" /> while Palpatine pronounces it "Kah-lay-vah-lah" in the subsequent episode, "Duchess of Mandalore."<ref name="DoM" />

Information on Kalevala and its place in the Mandalore system was provided by a brief inclusion in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEA" /> Kalevala's inclusion in the atlas came after Wallace had already written the entry on Mandalore and its star system, at a time when the Mandalore system's fourth orbit had been planned for a world known as Tal'tar. At the behest of [[Lucasfilm]], Kalevala was included in place of Tal'tar, and the previous world's attributes, including its orbital position and geography, were reassigned to Kalevala.<ref name="JCF">{{JCFCite|url=posts/32005615|board=Literature|thread=A question on Karen Traviss and her work(s)|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2011-12-06|time=6:27 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802142056/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/a-question-on-karen-traviss-and-her-work-s.31997188/page-8}}</ref>

The [[Wikipedia:Kalevala|''Kalevala'']] is the national epic of [[Wikipedia:Finland|Finland]].
